items.new_text: Given a stack profile declares its architecture rules as structured entries, when the profile is checked, then every bundled profile is still reported valid, and an old-style list of plain sentences is accepted too.

new_fr.title: Warning for outdated architecture rule format in profiles

items.new_text: Given a profile still uses the old plain-sentence list of architecture rules, when the profile is checked on request, then a warning is shown, and no other phase prints that warning.

new_fr.title: Architecture rule validation within a project profile

items.new_text: Given one architecture rule names both a linter fragment and a list of checking files, when the profile is checked on request, then that rule is reported as an error, the remaining rules stay usable, and the profile itself stays valid.

Given the list of allowed ways a rule can be kept is copied into the profile checker, when the tests run, then a test fails as soon as that copy differs from the constitution register, and the constitution register tests still pass.
